visual_base.visual_narrative_log: (1) A woman with short dark hair, wearing glasses and a floral-patterned shirt, stands in a brightly lit supermarket aisle. She is surrounded by shelves packed with various personal care products, primarily talcum powders. She holds a smartphone with a small lavalier microphone attached and gestures towards the products on the shelf. (2) The camera moves closer to the woman's face. She speaks directly to the lens with an engaging and serious expression, using her hands to emphasize her points about body odor and bacteria. Large variety-show style text captions occasionally appear on the screen to highlight keywords. (3) She holds a small, nearly invisible amount of white powder between her thumb and forefinger to demonstrate the use of baking soda. She mimics the action of applying a small amount to her underarm area while maintaining eye-contact. (4) The woman turns her head away from the camera with a playful, slightly apologetic smirk as she mentions 'taking away business.' The background remains the supermarket aisle. (5) The screen transitions to a clean white and gray background displaying the clinic's logo, social media handle, phone number, and physical addresses in both Chinese and English.
